headline: Digicontent notifies exchange of statutory agreement disclosure
summary: Digicontent Limited has submitted an intimation to the stock exchange regarding agreements under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR rules. The filing is a procedural compliance requirement for listed companies. No financial details or commercial terms of the agreements were disclosed in the initial notice. Indian retail investors should note this is standard corporate governance paperwork rather than a price-sensitive business event.
why_it_matters: No immediate financial impact on retail shareholders.
